newsitem.title: USA: PECO 1,055 MW Limerick, Pa. nuke in startup.
newsitem.headline: PECO 1,055 MW Limerick, Pa. nuke in startup.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt Limerick nuclear power unit 2 was moving into a startup mode early Wednesday following a maintenance outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
The unit was "pulling rods for startup" but was not yet producing any electricity, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The unit, located in Montgomery County, Pa., was taken off line January 30 for scheduled maintenance and refueling.
A company spokesman was not immediately available for comment on when the it will synchronize to the grid.
The adjacent 1,055 megawatt Limerick 1 nuclear power unit continued to operate normally at full capacity as of early Wednesday, the NRC said.
